name: IEWA Monday Night Bloodbath, 22 September 1997

date.source: The card's own dateline (subject line and posting date).

notes: The Damage half of the tag-title match is billed Kain and Die Maschine; 'Kain' also names a watched character-phrase under the standing memorial guard ("Coldblooded Kain"/"Kain Threat") -- this is a bare, unrelated ring name with no further characterisation on this card, flagged prominently and never resolved, per the same discipline the pre-read applied to two other bare-Kain hits elsewhere in this wave's corpus.

name: [IEWA] Pre-Tournament Predictions..
notes: A pre-tournament predictions broadcast for the first-ever IEWA North American Championship tournament (held the next day, 11 December 1996); the Heavyweight and Television Titles are noted as still vacant. The tournament's own participants (Mega Giant, Sean DiMarini, Big Poppa, Kevin Nash, D-Kid, Scott Hall, ECW, UFO) and its actual result are not minted here -- the result survives only as an unreadable uuencoded attachment (see this wing's enrichment note).
